name: CORAZA
recent: Coraza 近期因 ESOS 行使而分批发股，同时董事与主要管理层出现股权变动，包括执行主席减持及管理层接受 ESOS 期权。新闻方面，公司被报道有望再创盈利新高，并受惠于半导体设备资本开支周期。
notable: 公司因 ESOS 行使而发行新股，分别于 2026 年 10 月 12 日及 11 月 17 日上市。
执行主席 Lim Yook Yuen 于 2026 年 10 月 7 日减持 42,900 股普通股。
管理层 Lim Teik Hoe、Chester Tang Chian Chiun、Kor Han Chin 及 Lim Shiou Hwan 于 2026 年 11 月 5 日接受 LTIP 下的 ESOS 期权。
risks: 执行主席及主要管理层在近期有减持普通股的行动。
ESOS 行使导致股本逐步扩大，可能造成股权摊薄。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 MYR 51,045,000，环比增长 15.7%，同比增长 20.1%；净利为 MYR 5,432,000，环比增长 25.1%，同比增长 69.8%；净利率为 10.6%，高于上一季度的 9.8%。

recent_en: Coraza recently issued shares in batches due to ESOS exercises, while there were changes in director and key management shareholdings, including disposals by the Executive Chairman and acceptance of ESOS options by management. In the news, the company was reported to be on track for another record earnings year and riding the semiconductor equipment capex cycle.
notable_en: The company issued new shares due to ESOS exercises, listed on 12 Oct 2026 and 17 Nov 2026 respectively.
Executive Chairman Lim Yook Yuen disposed of 42,900 ordinary shares on 7 Oct 2026.
Management Lim Teik Hoe, Chester Tang Chian Chiun, Kor Han Chin and Lim Shiou Hwan accepted ESOS options under the LTIP on 5 Nov 2026.
risks_en: The Executive Chairman and key management recently disposed of ordinary shares.
ESOS exercises have gradually enlarged the share base, which may cause dilution.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 51,045,000, up 15.7% QoQ and 20.1% YoY; net income was MYR 5,432,000, up 25.1% QoQ and 69.8% YoY; net margin was 10.6%, higher than 9.8% in the previous quarter.
